course_name_original: Einführung in die Kryptographie und ihre Anwendungen
course_name_en: Introduction to Cryptography and its Applications
prerequisites: No prerequisites are required. Knowledge in programming, algorithms, networks, discrete mathematics, and algebra is useful. Prior knowledge in IT security is generally helpful but not required.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the most important basic principles and methods of cryptography, which are necessary for evaluating cryptographic security and its elementary application in other areas of computer science.
They understand these methods and are able to select suitable cryptographic procedures for specific application examples and implement them practically.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the most important concepts and methods of cryptography, especially encryption, authentication, network security protocols (e.g., TLS).
Discussion of these methods in both established and newer applications (e.g., data carrier encryption, VPNs, signature procedures, Cloud Security, Blockchains).

Practical application of concepts and methods through exercises and an integrated crypto practical, including security evaluation of cryptographic procedures and best practices for their use in various application scenarios.

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments. The grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. The examination performance consists of either an oral examination or a written exam.
bibliography: Douglas R. Stinson and Maura B. Paterson: Cryptography: Theory and Practice, CRC Press 2018
Johannes A. Buchmann: Introduction to Cryptography, Springer 2002
Johannes A. Buchmann: Einführung in die Kryptographie, 6. Auflage, Springer 2016
Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone: Handbook of Applied Cryptography, CRC Press 1996
